setup.pitch: Each autumn, Bellmere sets lanterns on the river for people who died far from home. This year the council removed lanterns for the unnamed dead—and something on the old road has begun carrying them back.
setup.gmSummary: Bellmere's Lanterns of Return festival sends named lanterns downriver for the dead who never came home. The original rite also included plain unmarked lanterns for strangers, missing travelers, and unidentified dead. This year council historian Olan Crest removed the anonymous lanterns to make the ceremony 'more personal' and easier to sponsor. At dusk, unlit lanterns begin appearing along the abandoned north road, carried by pale Road-Bearers who escort lost spirits toward town. The council assumes the figures are invading ghosts. In truth, the old road is trying to complete the omitted remembrance. The party must uncover the erased portion of the ritual, travel the ghost road, identify or acknowledge several forgotten dead, and decide whether Bellmere restores anonymous remembrance, creates a public memorial registry, or closes the supernatural road forever.
setup.background: Bellmere grew around a ferry crossing where wars, floods, and winter roads often left bodies unidentified. The Lanterns of Return began as a promise that even people without family in Bellmere would receive one light and one place in communal memory. Over generations the named lanterns became the visible tradition while the blank lanterns were treated as expendable. Olan removed them to reduce cost and focus the festival on family stories. The Road-Bearers are not revenants seeking vengeance; they are ritual escorts generated by the old promise, now physically returning the omitted dead to town.
setup.campaignFrame: Brother Halve accompanies Hearthford families to Bellmere's remembrance festival and recognizes that the omitted blank lanterns violate an older funerary custom. The party returns to Hearthford after the ghost road closes or settles, carrying whatever new memorial practice they chose.

quest.objective: Learn why the Lanterns of Return failed, escort or acknowledge the forgotten dead, and decide what Bellmere's memorial tradition should become.
quest.stakes: The ghost road is opening through occupied streets, frightened residents are attacking harmless spirits, and several unresolved dead are pulling dangerous memories into the present.
quest.deadline: RIVER OF LIGHT: show five lantern marks. Fill one after quay, archive, old road, crossroads, and memorial hill. At the fifth, the Road-Bearers enter Bellmere's square with every omitted lantern.
successConditions: The omitted dead are acknowledged or deliberately released.
The ghost road stops crossing occupied Bellmere streets.
The festival is resolved through Restore, Register, or Close.
failureConditions: The party abandons the town while the ghost road remains open.
The forgotten dead are violently dispersed without any replacement memorial process or road closure.

facts.text: The original festival included blank lanterns for unnamed, missing, and unidentified dead.

scenes.title: Lanterns Against the River
scenes.purpose: Launch the supernatural failure, show blank lanterns matter, and establish the festival clock.
scenes.readAloud: Bellmere's named lanterns drift downstream in gold lines—except for six unlit lanterns moving upstream against the current. One bumps the quay wall and rises upright in the water. Across the river, pale figures appear on the abandoned north road carrying more dark lanterns toward town.
gmNotes: Show RIVER OF LIGHT with five lantern marks. Fill 1/5 when the party leaves.
Mara can demonstrate that lighting one blank lantern calms the nearest spirit. No check is required.
DC 14 Intelligence (Religion or History) identifies the ritual pattern as incomplete; failure gives no false conclusion and the archive diagrams provide the same truth.
Do not start with combat. The Road-Bearers remain across the river and move only toward Bellmere.
Send the party to the Memorial Archive to compare this year's lantern inventory.

scenes.title: Lanterns for Nobody
scenes.purpose: Prove the deliberate omission and reveal the ghost road's historical precedent.
scenes.readAloud: The Memorial Archive is packed with named cards and family histories. One ledger has a clean gap where a whole category should be. In older books, the same line appears every year: UNNAMED / MISSING / UNCLAIMED. This year's entry is crossed out in red.
gmNotes: Fill RIVER OF LIGHT 2/5 when this scene ends.
DC 14 Investigation finds Olan's revised ledger, sponsor letter, and basement transfer sheet quickly. Failure costs time but all three remain physically available.
A prior incident log describes Road-Bearers after blank lanterns were accidentally omitted during a flood year.

Recovering six stored blank lanterns grants one prepared Restore success later.

scenes.title: Travelers Without Names
scenes.purpose: Demonstrate that the Road-Bearers are escorts and give the party direct control over individual unresolved spirits.
scenes.readAloud: The abandoned road is carpeted in red leaves, but none move beneath the pale procession. Three Road-Bearers walk toward you with dark lanterns. Between them drift figures that are less like ghosts than missing pieces of people: a coat with no face, a soldier with no insignia, a child holding an empty tag string.
gmNotes: Fill RIVER OF LIGHT 3/5 when three spirit examples are resolved or escorted onward.
Run three spirit cases: one identifiable by object, one permanently unknown, one misidentified in the archive.
A spirit settles if its real name is recovered OR it receives a blank lantern and an explicit acknowledgment such as 'Unknown traveler, found on the north road.'
DC 14 Investigation/History can identify the first spirit from belongings. Failure leaves the blank-lantern route fully valid.
If attacked, Road-Bearers defend by restraining and pushing; they do not pursue fleeing creatures.

scenes.title: The Burial Outside the Ledger
scenes.purpose: Reveal the unrecorded landslide burial and turn historical recovery into preparation for the finale.
scenes.readAloud: The road ends where half a hillside collapsed decades ago. Three marker stones lean from the earth. One still has a name. One has initials. One simply says UNKNOWN TRAVELERS. Around them, dozens of dim lanterns hang in the air without chains.
gmNotes: Fill RIVER OF LIGHT 4/5 when the burial cluster is acknowledged and Memorial Hill route opens.
Eden's survey proves the burial was never entered into town records.

Complete three memorial jobs: recover legible marker text, record the burial location, light one blank lantern for everyone still unknown. Each can be solved directly or with DC 14 Investigation/History/Religion as appropriate.
Failure on a job creates a Memory Echo: 2d6 psychic damage or one short false scene, but the job remains retryable and never generates false permanent information.
Completing all three jobs grants one prepared Register station in the finale.

scenes.title: Light, Record, or Shut
scenes.purpose: Resolve the remembrance crisis through restored anonymous memorial, permanent registry, or closure of the supernatural road.
scenes.readAloud: Bellmere glows below you as the fifth lantern mark ignites. The ghost road rises over the hill like pale cobblestone laid across the air. At the memorial gate, three iron mechanisms wait beneath carved words: LIGHT. RECORD. SHUT. Behind you, Road-Bearers arrive carrying more blank lanterns than anyone can count.
gmNotes: Memorial Gate has AC 16, 90 HP if attacked; the Road-Bearers are not the boss.

RESTORE/LIGHT: hang blank lanterns in three memorial arches. One prepared success may come from archive lanterns. Each remaining Action uses DC 14 Religion/History/Persuasion or an explicit acknowledgment of unnamed dead. Three successes before 2 failures end the road peacefully. Failure creates one Memory Echo and one failure; at 2 failures Restore closes but Register and Close remain legal.

REGISTER/RECORD: complete three stations—known dead, unidentified dead, future unknown-death procedure. Crossroads preparation can make one automatic. Each other station uses DC 14 Investigation/History/Persuasion. Three stations convert the ghost road into a permanent memorial route that opens only during the festival.

CLOSE/SHUT: break the road anchor after one deliberate closure action. Anchor AC 15, 26 HP. Destroying it ends all supernatural Road-Bearer activity permanently, but Bellmere must maintain memorial records without magical correction.

Initiative 20: Procession Advance. One 15-foot strip of the hill becomes occupied by passing spirits; creatures there make DC 14 Wisdom save or become Frightened until end of next turn. A lit blank lantern makes the holder immune to this effect.
Directly reducing the Memorial Gate to 0 HP counts as Close.

runSteps.title: State Light, Record, Shut
runSteps.text: All three routes are visible on the gate.

runSteps.title: Keep unnamed remembrance valid
runSteps.text: Do not force invented names.

runSteps.title: End as soon as one system works
runSteps.text: The ghost road dissolves or becomes controlled immediately.

scenes.title: Resolution: One Light for Whoever Is Missing
scenes.purpose: Reward restoring anonymous remembrance with explicit meaning.
scenes.readAloud: Blank lanterns join the named ones on the river. Nobody writes fake names on them. Nobody apologizes for the empty paper. Mara pushes one into the current and says, “For whoever did not make it home.” The Road-Bearers lower their staffs and fade.
gmNotes: Award 260 gp total and four Bellmere Favor lanterns.
Blank lanterns return permanently as a funded part of the festival.
Olan rewrites the public history to include anonymous remembrance.

runSteps.title: Keep blank space intentional

runSteps.title: Record reward

scenes.title: Resolution: The Book of Whoever Was Here
scenes.purpose: Reward a durable public process for both named and unidentified dead.
scenes.readAloud: A new memorial book opens on the quay. Some entries have names. Some have descriptions. Some read only UNKNOWN TRAVELER, FOUND NORTH ROAD. The ghost road narrows into a pale path that appears once each autumn and ends at the book.
gmNotes: Award 280 gp total and the Open Record token, granting advantage on one future Bellmere check involving research, identification, or civic records.
The registry requires location/date/evidence even when a name is unknown.
The Road-Bearers become harmless festival guides.

runSteps.title: Define minimum record
runSteps.text: Existence, place, and evidence are enough when identity is lost.

runSteps.title: Record reward
runSteps.text: Award 280 gp and Open Record token.

scenes.title: Resolution: No Road but the One We Keep
scenes.purpose: Respect closing the supernatural route while preserving documentary responsibility.
scenes.readAloud: The road anchor breaks. Every pale cobblestone vanishes at once. The unmarked lanterns remain in ordinary hands. Eden opens his survey beside the memorial book and starts writing before anyone has time to argue about whether the ghosts are really gone.
gmNotes: Award 260 gp total.
The supernatural road and Road-Bearers disappear permanently.
Bellmere still keeps the recovered burial records and must maintain remembrance through human institutions.

runSteps.title: Keep the records
runSteps.text: Closing magic does not erase recovered history.

runSteps.title: Record reward
runSteps.text: Award 260 gp.
